dataset: CTDOT OSTA State Highway Speed Limits
publisher: Connecticut DOT, Office of the State Traffic Administration (OSTA)
coverage: state highways only (OSTA-approved speed zones on state roadways)
fields: SpeedLimit (also RouteID, Direction, ApprovedDate, OSTANumber, StateOrLocalRoad)
updated: data.gov: data modified 2022-08-16, metadata 2025-02-12; layer last_edited_date not shown
license: none stated (data.gov: 'No license information was provided'; copyright text credits OSTA/UConn CTSRC)
notes: Polyline, maxRecordCount 5000, JSON/geoJSON/PBF query. Segments without an approved zone are labelled 'No approved speed zone' (no value). Local roads excluded: under PA 21-28 towns set local limits without OSTA. Parent group also has School Zone/local speed layers per data.gov description (not opened).
